name: FTSE 100
summary: FTSE 100 fell 1.8% to 10,690 on 17 Nov, 2.0% below its high; no daily fall above 2.5% this week
state: The FTSE 100 closed near 10,690 on 17 Nov, a fall of about 1.8% on the day and 1.3% on the week, leaving it 2.0% below its 52-week high of 10,911 (Yahoo Finance). That is inside both the 5% drawdown and 2.5% single-day fall Watch lines.
for_you: UK share prices affect pensions and investment funds; a fall of this size is within normal market movement. This describes conditions only.
why: The UK's main index — a gauge of UK-listed multinationals, pensions and sterling-area sentiment.
drivers: Commodity prices, sterling, global risk appetite, UK policy and banking sector news.
